env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Uploaded files auto-inlined into context (small) or readable on-demand via `read_uploaded_file` tool.
env_context_strategy.note: Also a RAG pipeline: Jina embedding + LanceDB + hybrid retrieval. Target is enterprise systems rather than repos.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Compaction now triggers with a safety margin below the model's input limit instead of exactly on it
context_compaction.note: The README mentions 'ContextGuard for 5-layer token-budget management'. The exact mechanisms are not shown in the evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Smart PDF mode extracts text from text-rich pages and renders scanned pages as images.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: GPT-5.x models now go through the Responses API first, where function tools and reasoning work together

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Beyond `find_replace`, agents can apply line-hunk patches with fuzzy whitespace matching via `file_ops.apply_patch`
edit_primitive.note: V4A patch format coded as unified_diff.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Import OpenAPI spec, AI chat builder, or connect MCP servers directly.
tool_schema_source.note: The source of the built-in tool schemas is not reported.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Connect APIs, databases, MCP servers. Actions auto-register as agent tools with auth injection.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Auto-routing — Classifies queries and routes to optimal mode (ReAct or DAG). Configurable via `AUTO_ROUTING`.
loop_primitives.note: DAG planner with auto re-plan up to 3 rounds.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Dynamic DAG planning — LLM decomposes goals into dependency graphs at runtime.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: It also states the current fact that every DAG step is already a full ReAct agent (not a one-shot LLM call).
multi_agent_topology.note: Applies in DAG mode only. ReAct mode is single-agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: every DAG step is already a full ReAct agent (not a one-shot LLM call)

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: posts an Approve / Reject card to your group when a sensitive tool call fires; the tool blocks until a group member taps a verdict.
human_in_loop.note: Three routing modes (Auto / Inline only / Channel only) are configurable.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: nudged to write a plan when working without one, and can no longer deliver a final answer while plan items are still open

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Global skills (SOPs) — Reusable operating procedures loaded for every user; progressive mode cuts tokens ~80%.
long_term_memory.note: The KB vector store is for RAG, not agent memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: clients auto-reconnect dropped SSE streams via `/chat/resume` with exponential backoff

self_verification.evidence_quote: can no longer deliver a final answer while plan items are still open without an explicit verification pass

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Independent steps run in parallel via asyncio; auto re-plan up to 3 rounds.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The agent now signals when it is done gathering and writes the answer as a live streamed turn
termination_condition.note: Other caps are not reported in the evidence.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Quota chain (per-user override → plan tier → system default) with `0` for unlimited.
cost_controls.note: Auto-routing chooses between modes, and a fast model is mentioned. Prompt-cache observability is also present.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Python, Node.js, shell exec with optional Docker sandbox (`CODE_EXEC_BACKEND=docker`).

permission_model.evidence_quote: `FeishuGateHook` gates sensitive tool calls behind a human approval card posted to a Feishu group.
permission_model.note: Applies to sensitive tools only. Whether it is on by default is unclear.

tracing.evidence_quote: surfaced in the chat `done` payload and logged so operators can verify cache hits

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Evaluation Center — Test-dataset management, parallel eval runs with LLM-graded judgments

guardrails.evidence_quote: Default jailbreak-phrase detector aborts the turn before the LLM is invoked
guardrails.note: Output guardrails are optional via FIM_GUARDRAILS_OUTPUT. Actions are covered by tool-permission hooks.

target_domain.evidence_quote: All-in-One Agent Platform for Global × China Enterprises.

open_source.note: Source is available but the license is not OSI-approved.
